{{Quote|I used to be proud to say, 'Lieutenant Doorn, Coruscant Security Forces.' These days, it's just a job. Doesn't even pay the bills.|Doorn|<ref name="SWTORpassages" />}}
'''Doorn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He worked as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and was able to achieve the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] period that followed the war, Doorn was posted to the [[Black Sun territory]]. The assignment was difficult, with constant street warfare against the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Like many veteran cops, Doorn became extremely cynical, frustrated, and burned out. At one point he was assigned the task of securing plans for Coruscant's [[Coruscant secret underground tunnels|secret tunnels]]. Working with [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Fieler Dan]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], Doorn tracked the plans to Coruscant's [[Justicar territory]]. When Dan failed to contact Doorn, he sent a Republic individual after her who was able to locate the plans.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't have the manpower to recover stolen intelligence! I&mdash;I can't just pull a commando unit out of my helmet, can I?|Doorn, discussing the Black Sun Territory|<ref name="SWTORpassages" />}}
Doorn, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. He had attained the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] before the outbreak of [[Great Galactic War|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was posted to the [[Black Sun territory]] which, due to the constant street warfare with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, was a hard assignment.<ref name="SWTORpassages" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> plans of [[Coruscant secret underground tunnels|secret tunnels]] underneath Coruscant were stolen by the vigilante [[Justicars' Brigade]] militia. Doorn was assigned the task of recovering the plans and sent a female [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], [[Fieler Dan]], to discover the location of the plans. However, Doorn lost communications with the SIS agent and requested the help of a Republic individual in locating her. The individual was able to infiltrate the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] and find the missing agent. Dan informed the individual where the plans were kept, but requested a copy of the plans so that she could give them to her [[Fieler Dan's daughter|daughter]] to help bring in food and supplies to the refugees. The individual was able to retrieve the plans and returned to Dan intending to give the schematics to Doorn. However, Dan pleaded with the individual to let her make a copy of the plans. The individual consented and then returned the plans to Doorn without telling him that copies had been made.<ref name="SWTORpassages" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Look at this place. Nothing but freeloading tramps. I don't know why we bother.|Doorn, discussing the Black Sun Territory|<ref name="SWTORpassages" />}}
Doorn was a Human male with light skin, [[black]] hair, and dark blue eyes. Though he had once been proud of both his job and his rank, he no longer felt so by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Cold War.<ref name="SWTORpassages" /> As with his fellow veteran cops,<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Coruscant Security}}</ref> Doorn felt burned out and frustrated. The constant street warfare had taken its toll on living conditions, and cops suffered as much as civilians. To Doorn, [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] work no longer served to keep the peace, but was instead a difficult job with barely enough pay.<ref name="SWTORpassages" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doorn appears as part of the "Secret Passages" Republic-sided mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The Republic character undertakes a mission for Doorn to secure plans of secret tunnels on Coruscant. The player can choose to not to let Dan make a copy as a dark side choice.
